alt: A hand presses against a wooden box above; below, another hand holds the handle of a red wagon.
A hand touches the left side of a wooden block; a blue arrow above points right, away from the hand.
A taut rope connects a hand at upper left to a wagon at lower right. An arrow points from the wagon toward the hand.
A wooden block rests on thick cream carpet, with carpet fibers visible against its lower edge.
An orange ball hangs above a level floor. A blue arrow beside it points straight down.
Four positions of a blue ball run from left to right; the earlier positions are paler than the final one.
A blue book rests on a table beside two matching vertical arrows, one pointing up and one pointing down.
A wooden wagon sits beneath a long blue arrow pointing right and a shorter orange arrow pointing left.
Three separate horizontal scenes each show an empty ramp and one blue ball resting at a similar distance beyond it.
A child holds a ball at the top of a ramp and points toward an empty circular marker on the floor beyond it.
At left, a child presses a box forward. At right, another child holds a wagon handle and draws it toward themselves.
Matching blocks sit on smooth tile at left and textured carpet at right. A blue arrow beside each block points right.
A child sits upright on a chair with their feet resting on the floor.
Two hands hold a taut rope with a central red ribbon. Matching blue arrows above point left and right.
Cords extend from both sides of a wooden cart. A short orange arrow points left; a longer blue arrow points right.
A helmeted child pedals a blue bicycle along a level park path.
A blue sneaker touches textured pavement at the heel, with its toe lifted.
A wooden block sits between a long blue arrow pointing right above it and a shorter orange arrow pointing left below.
Two empty wooden ramps rest on books. The shallow ramp at left has one book beneath its raised end; the steeper ramp at right has a taller support with three books.
A hand places one of three blue circular markers clustered on the floor beyond an empty ramp.
A dashed curved path ends near a blue ball, with a small arrow following the curve toward the ball.
A hand presses its palm flat against a brick wall.
A steel paperclip lies across a small gap from a red-and-blue bar magnet. An arrow above the clip points toward the magnet.
A child gently holds a blue ball near the top of a low ramp supported by one book, with clear floor beyond the ramp.
